_about: The editor's seed for docs/maps/world-revolutions/, read by tools/build-world-revolutions.mjs and never written by it. The shortlist the user approved on 2026-10-01 (tools/.cache/world-revolutions/shortlist.md), Stage 1: names, other names, time and place, each cited — a Wikipedia article at a pinned revision, a past exam question on two independent sites, or a Bengali country name from the pinned Natural Earth file. A null is pending: no source in the order (NCTB, government, Wikipedia bn then en, newspapers, Banglapedia) gives it. Leaders, causes and results come in Stage 4. A point names a pinned file and a key; the build takes the coordinates from the file.
